sources.title: Qwen3-8B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint: 8.2B total, 6.95B non-embedding; text generation, thinking switch, tool-use example; native 32768 context and validated 131072 with YaRN.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 launch explicitly includes Qwen3-8B among six dense open-weight models under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3ForCausalLM; 36 layers, 4096 hidden width, 32 query / 8 KV heads, untied embeddings, max_position_embeddings 40960 and no configured RoPE scaling.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Architecture section explicitly identifies Qwen3-8B as dense, using GQA, SwiGLU, RoPE, RMSNorm and QK-Norm. Active-per-token counts are specified for MoE models, not this dense variant.

sources.title: Qwen3 official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen3 as developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud; release history records April 29, 2025.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint repository contains Apache License Version 2.0.

name.note: Display spelling of official Qwen3-8B identifier.

family.note: Qwen3 belongs to the Qwen model family.

release_date.note: Explicit dated public release, including this size.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded total in billions; 8B is branding.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-per-token count; 6.95B is non-embedding, not active.

architecture.note: Dense causal Transformer with grouped-query attention.

context_window.note: Native limit retained; 131072 requires YaRN. Card explains the 40960 config allocation as 32768 output plus 8192 prompt tokens.

modalities.note: Text tokenizer and causal language generation.

reasoning.note: Explicit thinking mode controlled by enable_thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact Qwen3-8B tool-calling example through Qwen-Agent.

description.value: Dense 8.2B Qwen3 model with switchable thinking for chat, reasoning, and tool use
description.note: Retains supported capabilities and corrects total parameter precision.

patch.description: Dense 8.2B Qwen3 model with switchable thinking for chat, reasoning, and tool use
patch.notes: 8.2B is the developer-rounded total; 6.95B non-embedding is not an active count. Active parameters are not separately reported. Native context is 32768 tokens; 131072 requires YaRN. The default 40960 positional allocation is explained in the model card.

summary: Correct total from nominal 8B to developer-reported 8.2B and fill dense architecture. Retain native context and April 29 launch date. Active count remains null because the developer does not separately define it.
